author: /root personally
role: Exposed development; conditional oscillator and channel hypotheses only
window_function: w=140*s^3*(1-s)^3/L on each interval; w=w'=0 at endpoints
window_placement: Consecutive non-overlapping full nominal intervals from the first sample; endpoints set to first/last included samples, final short interval omitted and reported
regression: Unweighted real least squares on column-normalized four-column system; report raw and normalized singular values, rank, coefficients and complex residuals. No confidence intervals.
within_development_temporal_check: Fit first floor(2N/3) full windows, evaluate final windows with those unchanged coefficients; not an independent empirical test.
quadrature_checks: Trapezoidal integration on recorded times and repeated thinning by2and4 with endpoint handling; no frequency or force-domain rescaling guessed.
controls: Symbolic two-body solve and uniform-acceleration cancellation
Analytic manufactured envelopes with different homogeneous amplitudes; no selected experimental initial state
Common-filter commutation and differential-filter failure example
data_registration: R*exp(i Theta*pi/180); no phase unwrap needed. Equal time and carrier arrays verified. Physical channel assignment, force phase, filter, calibration and support motion remain hypotheses.
